svg.aria-label: GMM: normalize likelihoods into responsibilities Panel: Two unit-covariance Gaussians Panel: Bayes normalization for each sample Two unit-covariance Gaussians Feature x: -1.5 to 3.5 Feature y: -1.5 to 1.5 Samples (scatter): x0 X0 (0, 0); x1 X1 (1, 0); x2 X2 (2, 0) Component A contour: center (0, 0), radius 1 Component B contour: center (2, 0), radius 1 Radius-1 circles are equal-density contours, not membership boundaries. Every sample has responsibility for both components. Bayes normalization for each sample Prior | Density | Share X0 / A: 0.5 | 0.1592 | 0.8808 X0 / B: 0.5 | 0.0215 | 0.1192 X1 / A: 0.5 | 0.0965 | 0.5 X1 / B: 0.5 | 0.0965 | 0.5 X2 / A: 0.5 | 0.0215 | 0.1192 X2 / B: 0.5 | 0.1592 | 0.8808 Share: highlighted column $p(x|k)=e^{-d^2/2}/(2\pi)$ is a density. $r_k=\pi_kp(x|k)/\sum_j\pi_jp(x|j)$. Share is posterior; pairs sum to 1. Rounded. Illustrative 2D GMM with equal priors $0.5$, means $(0, 0)$ and $(2, 0)$, and identity covariance. $d$ is distance to the component mean.
